compiled_state.title: Write RED test: ci-python-skills.yml uses cache: 'pip' and requirements.lock install
compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
## Testing Mode
RED

## Story DD Coverage
This task is responsible for satisfying the following story done definitions:
- DD3: CI install pipeline uses actions/setup-python with cache: 'pip' against a checked-in lockfile so cold-runner pip install does not regress CI run duration.

## TDD Requirement
Write a failing test (RED phase) that will pass only after T2 edits ci-python-skills.yml to add cache: 'pip' and install from requirements.lock.

Given: .github/workflows/ci-python-skills.yml exists
When: the file is parsed as YAML
Then:
  - The setup-python step has `cache: 'pip'`
  - The install step uses requirements.lock (not bare `pip install pytest`)
  - A cache-path entry or dependency-path references requirements.lock

Test file: tests/skills/test_ci_workflow_pip_cache.py
Test function: test_ci_python_skills_uses_pip_cache_and_lockfile

The test must import PyYAML (or use stdlib json via pyyaml — but pyyaml is available via pytest ecosystem) to parse the workflow YAML and assert on the `with:` block of the setup-python step.

NOTE: pyyaml is not in pyproject.toml. Use `import yaml` only if available; otherwise parse with a targeted grep/substring assertion on the raw YAML text (stdlib-only approach preferred to avoid new dependency).

Use stdlib-only approach:
- Read the file as text
- Assert `cache: 'pip'` substring is present in the setup-python step
- Assert `requirements.lock` substring is present in the install step

RED marker: add to .test-index:
  .github/workflows/ci-python-skills.yml: tests/skills/test_ci_workflow_pip_cache.py [test_ci_python_skills_uses_pip_cache_and_lockfile]

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Unit tests pass (exit 0)
  Verify: bash tests/skills/run-python-tests.sh
- [ ] Lint passes (exit 0)
  Verify: ruff check tests/skills/test_ci_workflow_pip_cache.py
- [ ] Format check passes (exit 0)
  Verify: ruff format --check tests/skills/test_ci_workflow_pip_cache.py
- [ ] tests/skills/test_ci_workflow_pip_cache.py exists
  Verify: test -f tests/skills/test_ci_workflow_pip_cache.py
- [ ] Test function test_ci_python_skills_uses_pip_cache_and_lockfile is defined
  Verify: grep -q "def test_ci_python_skills_uses_pip_cache_and_lockfile" tests/skills/test_ci_workflow_pip_cache.py
- [ ] .test-index contains RED marker for the test
  Verify: grep -q "test_ci_python_skills_uses_pip_cache_and_lockfile" .test-index
- [ ] The test FAILS (RED) at this point — do NOT run ci-python-skills.yml changes yet
  Verify: python3 -m pytest tests/skills/test_ci_workflow_pip_cache.py::test_ci_python_skills_uses_pip_cache_and_lockfile -v 2>&1 | grep -q "FAILED"

## Retry Budget
MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3 (sonnet model)
On 3 consecutive sonnet failures: escalate to opus with full diagnostic context (all 3 failure messages)
On 3 consecutive opus failures (6 total): escalate to user with full failure history
If MAX_AGENTS: 0 at sonnet->opus escalation time: skip opus step, escalate to user immediately
